SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman, a business trip isn’t like a vacation.

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: tapi aku cuma pengin bareng kamu, Gran.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 就算是去工作也沒關係
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: たとえそれが仕事でも

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Of course. Don’t you feel the same, Manager?

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tentu aja. Kamu juga ngerasa gitu kan, Manajer?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Claro que sim. E você não?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: البته. شما هم همین احساس را ندارید، مدیر؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wherever I go, I like being with you, Yuman.

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هرجا برم دوست دارم با تو باشم یومان.

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ikut aku di perjalanan dinas berikutnya, ya.
